app.title: Inside the Transformer
app.tagline: Watch GPT-2 small turn text into new text, one token at a time, with real numbers.
intro.note: GPT-2 continues text: give it the start of a text and it adds one small piece after another. It does not answer questions the way a chat assistant does.

view.tokens.intro: The model does not read letters or words: it first splits the text into tokens, small pieces that each have a number.
view.embeddings.intro: Each token becomes a long list of numbers: one list for what the token is and one for where it stands, added together.
view.blocks.intro: The numbers pass through a stack of transformer blocks; in each one, attention mixes in information from earlier tokens and the MLP reshapes each token on its own.
view.attention.intro: Attention shows, for each token, how much it looks at each earlier token when it updates its numbers.
view.prediction.intro: At the end, the model gives every possible next token a probability, and greedy decoding always picks the most likely one.
view.architecture.intro: A map of the whole model with the real size of every part, read from the official model configuration.
view.cost.intro: Theoretical estimates of how much computation the model needs to read the text and to generate each new token.
view.method.intro: Every formula behind the parameter counts, compute estimates and memory figures, with its assumptions and a worked example.

architecture.component.wte.title: token embedding
architecture.component.wte.description: The token embedding: a table with one list of numbers for every token in the vocabulary. The model looks up the row of each input token.
architecture.component.wpe.title: position embedding
architecture.component.wpe.description: The position embedding: one list of numbers for every position in the text, up to the longest text the model can read ({p} tokens). It tells the model where each token stands.
architecture.component.ln_1.title: layer norm before attention
architecture.component.ln_1.description: Rescales each token's numbers to a standard range before attention. Its weight scales each of the {d} numbers and its bias shifts it.
architecture.component.attn_c_attn.title: query, key and value
architecture.component.attn_c_attn.descr: Turns each token's {d} numbers into a query, a key and a value for every attention head, all with one matrix.
architecture.component.attn_c_proj.title: attention output
architecture.component.attn_c_proj.descr: Combines the outputs of all attention heads into one list of {d} numbers per token, which is then added to the token's vector.
architecture.component.ln_2.title: layer norm before the MLP
architecture.component.ln_2.description: Rescales each token's numbers to a standard range again, this time before the MLP.
architecture.component.mlp_c_fc.title: expand {d} → {f}
architecture.component.mlp_c_fc.descript: The first MLP matrix: expands each token from {d} to {f} numbers. Then {activation} is applied to each of them.
architecture.component.mlp_c_proj.title: compress {f} → {d}
architecture.component.mlp_c_proj.descri: The second MLP matrix: compresses each token from {f} back to {d} numbers. The result is added to the token's vector.
architecture.component.ln_f.title: final layer norm
architecture.component.ln_f.description: The final layer norm: rescales each token's numbers once more after the last block, just before the LM head.
architecture.component.lm_head.title: next-token scores
architecture.component.lm_head.descripti: The LM head turns a token's final {d} numbers into a score (a logit) for each of the {v} tokens in the vocabulary.
architecture.tied_note: GPT-2 uses the same matrix for the LM head as for the token embedding ({name}): the weights are shared (“tied”). They are stored once and counted only once in the total.
architecture.panel.label: Selected part
architecture.panel.hint: Nothing selected yet. Select a weight or bias in the map to see its numbers here.
